lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਬਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevaa saphal hai banee ||
lines.translation: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit mil har naam dhiaaiaa har dhanee ||
lines.translation: meeting Him, I meditate on the Name of the Lord, the Lord Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਛੂਟੀ ਘਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jin har japiaa tin peechhai chhootee ghanee ||1||
lines.translation: So many are emancipated along with those who meditate on the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasikh har bolahu mere bhaaee ||
lines.translation: O GurSikhs, chant the Name of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਤ ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bolat sabh paap lahi jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, all sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਬ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab gur miliaa tab man vas aaiaa ||
lines.translation: When one meets the Guru, then the mind becomes centered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਪੰਚ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaavat pa(n)ch rahe har dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The five passions, running wild, are brought to rest by meditating on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਗਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: anadin nagaree har gun gaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Night and day, within the body-village, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur pag dhoor jinaa mukh laaee ||
lines.translation: Those who apply the dust of the Feet of the True Guru to their faces,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੂੜ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kooR tiaage har liv laaee ||
lines.translation: renounce falsehood and enshrine love for the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: te har daragah mukh oojal bhaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa aap har bhaavai ||
lines.translation: Service to the Guru is pleasing to the Lord Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਬਲਭਦ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: krisan balabhadr gur pag lag dhiaavai ||
lines.translation: Even Krishna and Balbhadar meditated on the Lord, falling at the Guru's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh har aap taraavai ||4||5||43||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself saves the Gurmukhs. ||4||5||43||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਡੰਡਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape jogee da(n)daadhaaree ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is the Yogi, who wields the staff of authority.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape rav rahiaa banavaaree ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself practices tapa - intense self-disciplined meditation;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ਲਾਇ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har aape tap taapai laai taaree ||1||
lines.translation: He is deeply absorbed in His primal trance. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa meraa raam rahiaa bharapoor ||
lines.translation: Such is my Lord, who is all-pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nikat vasai naahee har door ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He dwells near at hand - the Lord is not far away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape sabad surat dhun aape ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is the Word of the Shabad. He Himself is the awareness, attuned to its music.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape vekhai vigasai aape ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself beholds, and He Himself blossoms forth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har aap japaai aape har jaape ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself chants, and the Lord Himself inspires others to chant. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape saari(n)g a(n)mritadhaaraa ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the rainbird, and the Ambrosial Nectar raining down.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har a(n)mrit aap peeaavanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself leads us to drink it in.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har aap kare aape nisataaraa ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is the Doer; He Himself is our Saving Grace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੇੜੀ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape beRee tulahaa taaraa ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is the Boat, the Raft and the Boatman.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape guramatee nisataaraa ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself, through the Guru's Teachings, saves us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: har aape naanak paavai paaraa ||4||6||44||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself carries us across to the other side. ||4||6||44||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਹਮ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahu hamaaraa too(n) dhanee jaisee too(n) raas dehi taisee ham lehi ||
lines.translation: O Master, You are my Banker. I receive only that capital which You give me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣੰਜਹ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਜੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har naam vana(n)jah ra(n)g siu je aap daiaal hoi dehi ||1||
lines.translation: I would purchase the Lord's Name with love, if You Yourself, in Your Mercy, would sell it to me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham vanajaare raam ke ||
lines.translation: I am the merchant, the peddler of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har vanaj karaavai de raas re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I trade in the merchandise and capital of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: laahaa har bhagat dhan khatiaa har sache saah man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: I have earned the profit, the wealth of devotional worship of the Lord. I have become pleasing to the Mind of the Lord, the True Banker.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har jap har vakhar ladiaa jam jaagaatee neR na aaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: I chant and meditate on the Lord, loading the merchandise of the Lord's Name. The Messenger of Death, the tax collector, does not even approach me. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਅਨੰਤ ਤਰੰਗੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hor vanaj karahi vaapaareee ana(n)t tara(n)gee dukh maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those traders who trade in other merchandise, are caught up in the endless waves of the pain of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜੇਹੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇਆ ਫਲੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: oi jehai vanaj har laaiaa phal tehaa tin paaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: According to the business in which the Lord has placed them, so are the rewards they obtain. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har vanaj so jan kare jis kripaal hoi prabh deee ||
lines.translation: People trade in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, when the God shows His Mercy and bestows it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਲੇਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੪੫॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak saahu har seviaa phir lekhaa mool na leee ||4||1||7||45||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak serves the Lord, the Banker; he shall never again be called to render his account. ||4||1||7||45||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਨਨੀ ਗਰਭੁ ਪਾਲਤੀ ਸੁਤ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jananee garabh paalatee sut kee kar aasaa ||
lines.translation: The mother nourishes the fetus in the womb, hoping for a son,

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaa hoi dhan khaat dei kar bhog bilaasaa ||
lines.translation: who will grow and earn and give her money to enjoy herself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਦਾ ਦੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਥਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tiu har jan preet har raakhadaa de aap hathaasaa ||1||
lines.translation: In just the same way, the humble servant of the Lord loves the Lord, who extends His Helping Hand to us. ||1||
